CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_MONSTER_GREY_ANON.monolo: As if I could ever [red]accept[/red] this!

Once again, I've [red]lost[/red] my band, all over again!

The second time, I [red]worked my heart out[/red] for half a year
And then it got [red]destroyed[/red] again!
What even is that [red]Ave Mujica[/red]!
Wearing those [red]gorgeous[/red] outfits
With those [red]cool[/red] masks
[red]Performing[/red] on stage with that
Even though I [red]couldn't understand[/red] what it meant

[green]Mutsumi[/green]'s guitar is [red]so much better[/red] than mine!
[blue]Umiri[/blue]'s bass is so [red]reliable[/red] as always!
[blue]Sakiko[/blue]'s playing is so [red]inspired[/red]

[gold]Uika[/gold]'s guitar and singing are [red]way better[/red] than mine
No one [red]told[/red] me!
Everyone just [red]silently[/red] formed another band!
Even better than the band I [red]struggled so hard[/red] to build!
As if they were [red]born[/red] to form a band together!
Didn't you hear the [red]applause[/red] from the audience that night!
Such an [red]amazing[/red] song
Isn't it like they're [red]mocking[/red] me!

At first it was just [blue]Umiri[/blue]
Then [purple]Nyamu[/purple]
And then [orange]you[/orange] and [gold]Uika[/gold]
It really felt like a [red]dream[/red]!
We made a [red]promise[/red] to keep going together
I've always [red]believed[/red] in that!
If it meant I could [red]stay with everyone[/red]
I wouldn't care if I [red]couldn't smile[/red] anymore
Or if I [red]couldn't taste[/red] anything
Or even if I [red]collapsed on stage[/red]!
As long as I could [red]be with everyone[/red], I was happy!
But what is [red]this[/red] now!
Was I the only one who thought we'd [red]always be together[/red] as a band!
They just wanted to form an [red]even better band[/red]
And they [red]don't need me[/red], right!
I know I have [red]no talent[/red]
Whether it's [red]writing lyrics[/red]
Or playing [red]guitar[/red]
I'm completely clueless about [red]composing[/red]!
For the things I do understand, I have to [red]put in[/red] so much more effort than everyone else just to keep up
That [red]someone like me[/red] could be accepted by such amazing people
To become the leader of [purple]IF[/purple]
Happily [red]playing[/red] and happily [red]singing[/red] on stage
Those [red]sparkling moments[/red], I remember them no matter when!
And in my heart, I felt that [red]someone like me[/red] could also start again
I'm so [red]tired[/red]
Ever since I came back from England, it's like [red]nothing good has happened[/red]
Even when [pink]good things[/pink] happen, they just turn into [red]bad things[/red]
From the very beginning, I met [blue]Tomori[/blue]
I met [orange]Soyo[/orange]
I met [purple]Rikki[/purple]
I met [green]Rana[/green]
And we formed a band that, even now, doesn't even have a [red]name worth remembering[/red]
Although there were [red]unpleasant[/red] times back then
But when I promised to move forward together with [blue]Tomori[/blue] at the aquarium
I truly made up [red]my mind[/red]!
After that, [red]training together[/red] with the band
Making [red]new songs[/red] together
Our first live was [red]truly joyful[/red]!
Back then, I truly believed I could be in [blue]a band with everyone for a lifetime[/blue]!
But I [red]failed[/red]!
Because [blue]Crychic[/blue] still lived in their hearts!
I didn't care that [orange]Soyo[/orange] was just using me at first
I only played in a band to [red]stand out[/red]!
I was [red]using[/red] her too!
So it [red]didn't matter[/red] to me
But what about [blue]Sakiko[/blue]!
I finally became friends with [blue]her[/blue]
[blue]She[/blue] was just like me
Like [blue]Tomori[/blue]
[orange]Soyo[/orange]
[green]Mutsumi[/green]
[purple]Rikki[/purple]—they were all [red]trapped in the past[/red]
At the time, I just thought, if that's the case, I'll help them revive [blue]Crychic[/blue]
I really [red]didn't expect[/red] it to succeed

Since everyone [red]didn't need me[/red]

The first time I [red]seriously learned guitar[/red]
My first [red]live[/red]
The [red]emotion of our first successful[/red] band performance—all of that belonged to that band!
It was only after reviving [blue]Crychic[/blue] that I realized how important that band was to me!
But I had already [red]destroyed it with my own hands[/red]!
That band wasn't destroyed by [orange]Soyo[/orange]
Not by [blue]Tomori[/blue]
Not by [blue]Sakiko[/blue]
Not by [purple]Rikki[/purple]
Not by [green]Mutsumi[/green]
And certainly not by [green]Rana[/green]
I [red]destroyed it with my own hands[/red]!
Do you know what that [red]means[/red]!!
So I could only go form a new band with [green]Rana[/green]
Because I had destroyed [green]Rana[/green]'s place to belong
I had to give her a [red]new place to belong[/red]!
That was my [red]responsibility[/red]!
And that's how I was able to [red]meet[/red] everyone
To form a [red]new band[/red]
I thought I would [red]forget[/red] about that band!
But I truly [red]can't forget it for the rest of my life[/red]!
[blue]Hekitenbansou[/blue] is a song that belongs to that band
It was the first time I felt the [red]joy of playing music[/red]!
It was like I became [red]one with the stage[/red]
I [red]dream[/red] of playing together with everyone again!
But it's [red]already over[/red]!
So [purple]IF[/purple] is my [red]new place to belong[/red]!
Being [red]accepted[/red] by everyone made me really, really happy
Why did [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] have to poach from my band to form hers
Someone as [red]amazing[/red] as [blue]her[/blue]
Couldn't she just find other [red]amazing[/red] people to play in her new band!
Besides, does she have some grudge against [blue]Crychic[/blue]!

Fine if [blue]she[/blue] [red]doesn't want me[/red]
But why doesn't she even want [blue]Crychic[/blue]!
Does she have a problem with me reviving [blue]Crychic[/blue]!
Anyway, I'm already [red]not needed by them[/red]
I could only [red]cling to my guitar[/red]
And just [red]keep practicing[/red]
I thought that as long as my guitar skills could keep up, I wouldn't be [red]abandoned[/red]
So I practiced like [red]crazy[/red]
Even if it meant [red]not sleeping[/red]
Even if it meant [red]not eating[/red]
As long as I [red]practiced guitar[/red], I felt I could still [red]be needed[/red]
But even [red]that dream[/red] is over now!
It turns out that even if I hadn't been left behind, I would have been [red]abandoned[/red]!
It's not just [red]a matter of once or twice[/red] anymore
This is just the kind of [red]person I am[/red]!
When it comes down to it, I'm still [red]using[/red] them even now!
As long as [blue]Crychic[/blue] still exists
As long as [red]that band[/red] is still in my heart
I can never [red]escape[/red] this shadow!
Guitar is just the crutch of my [red]escapism[/red]
But by [red]now[/red], I've already gotten used to it!
Even though I [red]can't make[/red] any expressions anymore!
But I was happy going to school with [blue]Sakiko[/blue] and [orange]Mana[/orange]!
I was happy playing with [green]Rana[/green]!
Receiving [blue]Tomori[/blue]'s poems every day also made me happy!
When I met you, [orange]Mana[/orange]
The day I ran into [gold]Uika[/gold] was also a happy one!
When [purple]Nyamu[/purple] filmed me and the audience liked it, that made me happy too!
When [purple]Rikki[/purple] opened my guitar case, I was happy!
During performances, when [blue]Umiri[/blue]'s bass supported me from behind, I was happy!
When [orange]Soyo[/orange] wrapped a scarf around me, I was happy!
Being able to entrust everything to [gold]Uika[/gold] also made me happy!
Taking care of vegetables in the field with [green]Mutsumi[/green] and [blue]Sakiko[/blue] back then was also fun!
Actually, ever since [purple]IF[/purple]'s first performance
Ever since I reconnected with everyone from [blue]Crychic[/blue]
[pink]Good things[/pink] kept happening!
But all of that was just me [red]using[/red] everyone!
I'm [red]vain[/red] and [red]greedy for attention[/red]!
Everyone only saw [red]the way I am now[/red]
They [red]cared[/red] about me, so they paid attention to me!
The audience [red]too[/red]!
[purple]IF[/purple]'s songs are the [red]screams from my heart[/red]!
If I don't [red]vomit[/red] my heart out
If I don't [red]give it my all and burn[/red] myself out
[red]How could[/red] anyone possibly pay attention to me!
So I have no choice but to [red]force[/red] myself to keep being this way!
What if [red]I could smile[/red] again
What if everyone [red]stopped caring[/red] about me
I [red]can't bear to think[/red] about that!
So I have to [red]keep going like this[/red]!
And then one day I realized that [red]this mask[/red] had actually become me!
The [pink]smiling me[/pink] from before has become nothing but an [red]illusion[/red]!
I can't [red]go back[/red] anymore!
[blue]Sakiko[/blue] must have seen through this [red]false me[/red]
And decided to use this method to expose the [red]ugly[/red] me!
I know [blue]she[/blue] wants to [red]save[/red] me

Killed by the [red]Anon Chihaya[/red] of today
Damn it! [red]'All I have left is my guitar'[/red]—what a joke

[red]Turning a blind eye[/red] to the screams in my heart
That's how [red]despicable[/red] I am!
I [red]know it all[/red], crystal clear!
That's why, when I saw that performance, I [red]despaired[/red]!
I know they want to [red]save[/red] me!

The answer is definitely [red]no[/red], right
So I'm already [red]unable to move[/red]
Listen, this isn't anyone's [red]fault[/red]
All of this is my own [red]decision[/red]!
I, who wanted to be in the spotlight, have reached a [red]dead end[/red]!
So all I can do is [red]leave[/red]!
That way, at least I can keep [red]that image[/red] in everyone's hearts
And as for me, pretending to [red]ignore[/red] their concern
I must have already [red]deeply hurt[/red] everyone!
So I can no longer [red]face[/red] them!
I've been [red]deceiving[/red] everyone all along!
This is the [red]real me[/red]!
Even now, I still [red]want to run away[/red]!

I want to [red]start over once more[/red]
But I'm still so [red]afraid[/red]!

[red]Should I smile[/red]!
[red]Can I even smile[/red] anymore!
I who have [red]deceived[/red] everyone
I who have [red]hurt[/red] everyone
Do I really [red]deserve[/red] to be cared about so much!
So at [red]this point[/red]
Even if it [red]kills me inside[/red]
I have no choice but to [red]give up[/red] everything, aaahhh!!!
